scope: Truthful sync presentation after initial/unverified state, interruptions, unsent work and success; actual isolated Mac failure/reconnect and iPhone normal/light plus accessibility XXXL/dark interruption/Retry.
fix: No Up to date fallback before a successful sync.
Current notice takes precedence over an old successful timestamp, including zero pending uploads.
Pending edits use a waiting cloud icon rather than success checkmark.
iOS no longer describes a failed fetch as 0 changes waiting to sync.
iPhone/iPad wording refers to this device.
Status has one readable iOS accessibility element; Mac text wraps to two lines.

core.covered: Initial state; failed sync with/without prior success; 1/2 pending edits after success; local/offline/in-flight precedence; confirmed-success icon; existing readable failure messages.

macNative.scope: Genuine URLSession notConnectedToInternet from DEBUG-only exact bundle/disposable account hook; system networking untouched. Normal quit/relaunch removes process-only outage and performs successful server fetch.
macNative.byteHashNote: Normal load/persist/member refresh changes authenticated cache hashes; no byte-identical claim for that account. Imported account hash remains unchanged.
macNative.warnings: Existing NSTableView diagnostic remains; not a warning-free Mac claim.

checks: Real URLSession interruption with zero pending uploads.
Full accessible Sync needs attention label.
Retry is hittable and returns to failure status.
Full-screen screenshots visually inspected; status/reason/Retry readable.
iOSNative.dedicatedHook: Extends existing DEBUG+Simulator outage allowlist only to calendaraccessibilitytests with exact disposable account A; original test bundle behavior preserved.
iOSNative.scopeLimit: No iOS successful reconnect, physical device or full VoiceOver acceptance claimed.

initialFailure.finding: Status identifier inherited by image child; first query selected the icon instead of readable status. Fixed by exposing a single explicit accessibility element and label.

preservation.phoneInitialRawHashNote: Initial normal startup reserialized the authenticated JSON. No byte-identical initial-cache claim; final continuation compares every decoded top-level workspace file before/after and is exact.

limitations: Broader native concurrency, widgets, notifications, external providers, spoken VoiceOver and distribution gates remain open.
Other unrelated iOS staged source files remain older; acceptance is limited to the current owned status/transport/UI source and test.
